It doesn’t matter if he’s working behind the camera as a cinematographer, as he has to great acclaim on films like Julie Dash’s Daughters of the Dust or Spike Lee’s Malcolm X and Crooklyn; directing iconic music videos for the likes of Jay-Z, Solange, and Kanye West; or confronting the realities of Black American life through his video art practice, as he did in his 2016 masterpiece Love Is the Message, the Message Is Death. Jack Kirby in particular: Fantastic Four, Silver Surfer, Captain America, mostly Marvel comics. Even though I was very aware of DC, Superman and Batman primarily, it was the Marvel comics that had the most primordial effect on me. I used to have metal comic book stands. This is before comic stores and all this kind of stuff; you’d buy comics in convenience stores. I remember looking at covers of Fantastic Four when I was four years old.
